nodes.label: Product Backlog Emergen
nodes.rationale: Scrum Product Backlog as the single ordered, evolving source of requirements; kept current via continuous refinement.

nodes.label: Emergen - Plataforma Multiplataforma de Emergencias
Product Goal
nodes.rationale: Long-term outcome, not a feature list: one-gesture geolocated alerts to support contacts, secure access to critical medical info, centralized management of linked accounts; emphasizes speed, reliability, security, multiplatform access in crisis.

nodes.label: Marco Scrum
Definition of Done Fase 1
nodes.rationale: Deliverable stored in repo, peer-reviewed by another member, acceptance criteria met with evidence, weekly class feedback logged, backlog and master table updated.

nodes.label: MVP (8 HU criticas)
nodes.rationale: 8 critical user stories (HU-01..HU-08) isolated as the emergency-communication core to ensure an early functional increment.

nodes.label: Sprints semanales
nodes.rationale: One-week sprints match the academic schedule so each weekly class serves as Sprint Review; relative Story Point estimation lets two Developers avoid saturation.

nodes.label: JWT (JSON Web Token)
Cifrado AES-256
Fallback a ultima ubicacion conocida (GPS 3s)
nodes.rationale: If GPS does not respond within 3 seconds, the last known saved location is attached so the alert is never delayed.

nodes.label: Confirmacion SOS por pulsacion de 2 segundos
nodes.rationale: Require holding the SOS button ~2 seconds to avoid accidental activations.
